name: Universally Loved
source:
Talk your way out of the apocalypse.

Convince a trio of gods that you deserve to be the ultimate distraction...
And/Or die trying.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/869100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
用你的话语从末日中脱身。

说服三位神明，让他们相信你值得成为终极消遣……
并且／或者，在尝试中死去。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/869100/]Steam[/url]）
